subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters P, Q, R, S, T and U are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/354452c363b00e66a0125eecd35cd1a7549680e666887e0a33a39850ce510181.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'Q', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from P we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22cf6dba3cd649f2c87cfe9653488632b237062d2aec1c294ce5d949e865ceb8.png] 

In dice 2 P is adjacent to S and U.

In dice 3, P is adjacent to R and T.

→ P ⇔ P; U ⇔ R; S ⇔ T

So, the remaining 'P' will be the opposite face of 'Q'.

Hence, the correct answer is "P".
